promos.title: The Forgery and The Dead Mother
promos.hook: Mira confronts Dev for forging her father's name on the legal deed.
promos.cliffhanger: A mysterious lawyer presents a photo revealing the real owner is Mira's supposedly dead mother.
promos.why_it_works: High physical aggression transitions directly into a game-changing family twist.
promos.transcript:
[0:00.0] CAM: Medium shot of Mira holding the deed up to the light.
[0:00.5] MIRA (Accusing): "You forged my father's name."
[0:03.7] DEV (Panicked): "Keep your voice down!"
[0:05.5] ACTION: Dev grabs Mira's wrist; she twists free.
[0:07.7] TARA (Sharp): "Dev, you told me it was clean."
[0:10.2] SFX: The door bell rings again.
[0:11.5] CAM: A tall woman in a grey suit steps in out of the rain, holding a leather folder.
[0:14.2] LAWYER (Calm): "None of you can sell this bakery."
[0:18.0] MIRA (Stunned): "Who are you?"
[0:19.8] LAWYER (Measured): "The lawyer for its real owner. And she's been waiting twenty years."
[0:24.2] DEV (Afraid): "Real owner?"
[0:26.0] CAM: Close-up on the lawyer opening the folder to reveal a faded photograph.
[0:29.2] LAWYER (Quiet): "Mira... the woman in this photo is your mother."
[0:33.2] MIRA (Breathless): "My mother is dead."

confusions: The exact relationship between Mira, Dev, and Tara is never explained.
Why does the lawyer claim the real owner has been waiting twenty years?
Mira's mother is said to be dead, yet the lawyer presents a photo of her.
judge.verdict: Intriguing family drama with a twist.

promos.why_post_first: high emotional punch (7/10); brutal cliffhanger (7/10); from Ep 2 so new viewers hit the payoff early; tests the 'Confronting the Forgery' arc; trope: forged signature

promos.title: The Engagement Night Betrayal
promos.hook: Tara enters with Mira's fiance Dev and snarls 'Not for you, sweetheart' before dumping a deed on the counter.
promos.cliffhanger: Mira notices the signature on the back of the deed is forged, causing Dev to panic.
promos.why_it_works: A brutal engagement night betrayal instantly turns into a crime reveal with massive stakes.
promos.transcript:
[0:00.0] CAM: The door bell jingles as Dev enters with Tara on his arm.
[0:02.7] TARA (Smug): "Not for you, sweetheart."
[0:05.3] ACTION: Tara slaps a signed deed onto the counter, knocking the cake topper over.
[0:07.1] MIRA (Confused): "Dev? What is this?"
[0:09.1] DEV (Cold): "I sold the bakery. Your father's bakery. To Tara."
[0:12.6] MIRA (Shattered): "You were going to marry me tomorrow."
[0:15.2] DEV (Dismissive): "I was going to marry the bakery. Now I don't need to."
[0:18.3] CAM: Close-up on Mira's trembling hands gripping the counter.
[0:20.7] TARA (Gloating): "You have until sunrise to get out."
[0:23.9] ACTION: Mira picks up the deed and notices her father's handwriting on the back.
[0:26.7] MIRA (Whispering): "Wait... this isn't his signature."

confusions: The nature of Dev and Mira's relationship (engaged?) is only hinted at.
Tara's role and why she is with Dev are unclear.
Dev's line about marrying the bakery is cryptic without context.
judge.verdict: Betrayal and a shady deed keep the tension high.

promos.why_post_first: high emotional punch (8/10); brutal cliffhanger (8/10); from Ep 1 so new viewers hit the payoff early; tests the 'Engagement Betrayal' arc; trope: betrayal
